score: mean absolute change in predicted probability, all selected test patients, each diagnostic output separately
primary_estimand: For each task and method: (method score minus random score) under energy-matched consistent perturbation minus (method score minus random score) under independent perturbation; then average across three model seeds.
secondary_estimand: Analogous target-matched contrast; pairwise method-ranking contrasts; other budgets and strata.
intervals: Paired patient bootstrap, seed-average first, percentile 99.1667% intervals for six primary contrasts (Bonferroni family adjustment); descriptive 95% intervals elsewhere.
equivalence_margin_justification: Exploratory operational margin of one percentage point in mean absolute probability response; not a validated clinical margin. Report sensitivity at 0.005 and 0.02.
negative_result_rule: Equivalence only if adjusted primary interval lies wholly within +/-0.01 and every model-task passes validation gate. Crossing zero alone is inconclusive.
scope: Algebraic limb-lead measurement consistency, not physiologically realistic replacement, causal lead importance, clinical explanation correctness, or a general on-manifold guarantee.
